title_zh: Syll：支持跨界面执行的开源个人自动化系统
one_line: Harness routes tasks across MCP/API, CLI and GUI control and replays demonstration skills; evidence is a few single-run live mechanism probes.
one_line_zh: 开源智能体框架在 MCP/API、命令行与 GUI 间路由执行并回放演示技能，仅以少量单次实机机制探针验证。

online_eval.quote: The farm-world HUD gives a deterministic success condition.

variance.quote: Study B is a single paired replay ( n=1 per condition) that exercises the demonstration schema and replay loop, not statistical robustness or environmental perturbation (resolution, theme, language).

strong_baselines.quote: Timing, model calls, tokens, screenshots, and estimated cost are reported as local efficiency metadata, not cross-system rankings.

budget_matched.quote: Demonstration guidance mainly changes phase indexing and long-tail cue grounding, not the model-call budget.

cost_reported.quote: Efficiency anchors 148.2 s ; 8 shots; 16 calls; 43.3 k tokens 201.1 s ; 15 shots; 17 calls; 43.2 k tokens

component_ablation.quote: We fix the GUI actor, executor, task instruction, and initial setup, varying only whether Syll provides the demonstration skill artifact.

code.quote: The release package includes task setup scripts, Study C’s deterministic driver, success checks, run-date prompt and provider configuration, workspace layout, JSONL event logs, GUI replay evidence, and the pricing table used for cost fields.

evidence_level.quote: A3b (Photoshop on a 1024{\times}1024 image) and A3c (Audition on a 6.2 s speech clip) require multi-step GUI actuation.

S5.quote: Syll selects the narrowest route that can complete the task while preserving the audit surface required by policy or by the user.

AP5.quote: In demo-guided replay , the actor receives the instruction u , screenshot I_{k} , and the demonstration artifact with keyframes \mathit{kf} and semantic traces \mathit{trace} .

AP8.quote: Study B is a single paired replay ( n=1 per condition) that exercises the demonstration schema and replay loop, not statistical robustness or environmental perturbation (resolution, theme, language).

title_zh: RunAgent SuperBrowser：基于人类浏览行为的自主网页导航理论
one_line: Prompted web agent with bounded ledger memory, context eviction, three roles and chevron-aware snapping; Mind2Web Hard 89.47% without component ablations.
one_line_zh: 以有界结构化账本、上下文淘汰、三角色分工和小控件优先点击构建网页智能体，在 Mind2Web Hard 达 89.47%，但无组件消融。

online_eval.quote: We evaluate SuperBrowser on the Mind2Web Hard subset—66 long-horizon real-website tasks designed to stress generalisation across domains and UI styles ( Deng et al., 2023 ) .

strong_baselines.quote: Figure 6 compares SuperBrowser against twenty-one published baselines on the same 66-task subset.

budget_matched.quote: Each task runs with a 50 -step budget and a 5 -minute wall-clock budget.

cost_reported.quote: Each task averages 11 vision calls and \sim 22 LLM calls under our 50 -step budget.

component_ablation.quote: That sweep is left to future work; here we report the measured behaviour of the full system on the diagnostic task and the per-mechanism instrumentation it exposes.

validator_check.quote: Full-system measurement Value Task success (LLM judge) Yes (verified listings)

code.quote: We will release the eval harness alongside the camera-ready paper.

evidence_level.quote: Our primary metric is task-level success: a task is considered successful only if every required action subsequence executed correctly and the final outcome matches the reference.

F1.quote: It receives the page state, a condensed history, and the current Ledger render, and emits a JSON object with observation , challenges , done , next_steps , final_answer , and reasoning fields. This is the only place “the task is done” can be declared.

F4.quote: The cleanest test of each component is a counterfactual single-component ablation—remove one mechanism, hold the model, vision tier, and budgets fixed, and re-run the suite. That sweep is left to future work

AP4.quote: Full-system measurement Value Task success (LLM judge) Yes (verified listings)

AP8.quote: We present this as a single-task case study: holding the task fixed and varying only the Worker isolates the model effect cleanly

AP9.quote: That sweep is left to future work; here we report the measured behaviour of the full system on the diagnostic task and the per-mechanism instrumentation it exposes.

AP18.quote: a six-phase eviction loop systematically discards stale screenshots, state blobs, and reasoning traces from the live context.

title_zh: AliyunConsoleAgent：在真实云环境中通过蒸馏与强化学习训练网页智能体
one_line: SFT-then-GRPO 32B console agent with audit-log rule rewards and provisioned real cloud accounts; 278 live tasks, 3 runs, 63.52%.
one_line_zh: 在真实云控制台中以审计日志规则奖励和资源预置环境做蒸馏 SFT 加 GRPO，278 项实机任务三次运行达 63.52%。

online_eval.quote: All 278 tasks are verified exclusively via rule-based ActionTrail audit rules (no LLM-as-judge in evaluation).

held_out_env.quote: The evaluation set is isolated from training data at the document level—no document URL appearing in SFT or RL rollouts is included in the benchmark.

variance.quote: Each task is executed 3 independent times; we report both pass@1 (mean success rate \pm standard deviation across runs) and pass@3

strong_baselines.quote: Model Deployment Cost pass@1 pass@3 Qwen3-VL-32B-Instruct (Base) Private 0.56 43.28 \pm 0.50 % 60.79% AliyunConsoleAgent-32B (SFT) Private 0.56 56.89 \pm 0.83 % 72.66%

budget_matched.quote: we assign a per-sub-step interaction budget of 40—effectively a dynamic max-turn limit that scales with task complexity.

cost_reported.quote: All AliyunConsoleAgent-32B variants share identical deployment infrastructure (4 \times L20 GPUs at 0.4 QPS (queries per second)), yielding a per-task cost of approximately 0.56 CNY.

component_ablation.quote: On ECS, parallel execution with empty-account resource provisioning lifts success from 33.81% (baseline (i)) to 84.39% (+50.58 pp)

validator_check.quote: On a separate set of 308 expert-labeled trajectories for reward model validation

code.quote: we open-source our evaluation benchmark, filtered training data, Rollout environment infrastructure, and model training code at https://github.com/AlibabaResearch/aliyun-console-agent .

evidence_level.quote: Experiments on a challenging 278-task benchmark where the best frontier model achieves only 65.34% demonstrate that AliyunConsoleAgent-32B achieves a 63.52% mean success rate

S1.quote: Channel 1 (Rule-Based): for tasks with deterministic success criteria, we query ActionTrail audit logs to verify task completion, providing ground-truth binary rewards with zero false positives.

S2.quote: This design is resistant to reward hacking: the agent must produce verifiable backend state changes rather than merely convincing a judge model.

F2.quote: f_{\theta_{t}} is a task-specific verification rule that checks for expected API events and parameter constraints. All verification rules are validated by domain experts to ensure correctness.

AP5.quote: The model freely interacts with the console from high-level product entry points (e.g., ECS, RDS), autonomously proposing and executing CRUD (create, read, update, delete) tasks to maximize UI coverage across products and interaction types

title_zh: WebChallenger：可靠且高效的通用网页智能体
one_line: DOM-derived sectioned page representation with selective extraction, offline site exploration memory and compound actions; open 32B model, four live web benchmarks, ablations.
one_line_zh: 将 DOM 构造成带摘要的语义分区并选择性提取，配合离线站点探索记忆与复合动作，用开源 32B 模型在四个在线网页基准上评测并消融。

online_eval.quote: Using off-the-shelf open-weight models without fine-tuning, our system achieves 56.3% on WebArena, 48.7% on VisualWebArena, 51.0% on Online-Mind2Web, and 70.9% on WorkArena

held_out_env.quote: For each benchmark, we first explore the full set of benchmark websites before running inference.

variance.quote: For all experiments we use the same agent prompts and sample with temperature 0.

strong_baselines.quote: The bottom row uses the minimal GenericAgent harness from BrowserGym ( Chezelles et al., 2025 ) with the same GLM-4-32B model used in our system to isolate the contribution of our harness.

cost_reported.quote: Tokens/Prompt is the average input token count per LLM call. We count compound actions as one step.

component_ablation.quote: Among the three components, removing the observation pipeline causes the largest accuracy drop ( -17.6 points), followed by compound actions ( -9.7 ) and memory ( -7.6 ).

evidence_level.quote: Online-Mind2Web ( Xue et al., 2025 ) consists of 300 tasks across 136 real-world websites. We score our agent using human evaluations for Online-Mind2Web.

S5.quote: Removing the observation pipeline reduces total tokens ( 47.0 M \rightarrow 36.0 M) but raises average prompt size 4.75\times ( 1850\rightarrow 8793 tokens) and step count from 7.2 to 11.26 (Table 3 ).

AP5.quote: For each benchmark, we first explore the full set of benchmark websites before running inference.

AP8.quote: For all experiments we use the same agent prompts and sample with temperature 0.

title_zh: GUI-AC：增强 GUI 智能体的持续学习能力
one_line: Certainty-scaled advantage and dynamic clipping for GRPO grounding under continual domain/resolution shifts; ScreenSpot-only evidence, one 3B backbone.
one_line_zh: 在持续的领域与分辨率迁移下，以定位确定性缩放 GRPO 优势并动态放宽裁剪，仅在 ScreenSpot 系列上以 3B 模型验证。

online_eval.quote: GUI-AC achieves state-of-the-art performance on the ScreenSpot-V1, V2, and Pro benchmarks, delivering robust improvements in training stability and continual generalization.

strong_baselines.quote: We adopt Qwen2.5VL-3B Bai et al. (2025) as the vision–language backbone and use the same task format as GUI-AiF Liu et al. (2026) for a controlled comparison.

cost_reported.quote: All models are trained on 4 \times NVIDIA A100-80G GPUs with bfloat16; FlashAttention-2 and gradient checkpointing are enabled for efficiency.

component_ablation.quote: We isolate the two certainty-calibrated components by activating either Adaptive Advantage (GUI-A) or Dynamic Clipping (GUI-C) alone.

code.quote: Code is available anonymously at https://github.com/Can-Lin/GUI-AC.

evidence_level.quote: We evaluate on ScreenSpot-V1 (SSv1) Cheng et al. (2024) , ScreenSpot-V2 (SSv2) Wu et al. (2024) , and ScreenSpot-Pro (SSPro) Li et al. (2025) .

F1.quote: GUI-AC achieves state-of-the-art performance on the ScreenSpot-V1, V2, and Pro benchmarks, delivering robust improvements in training stability and continual generalization.

F4.quote: Across methods, icon grounding remains more difficult than text grounding, likely because small icons provide limited visual evidence in dense professional interfaces.

F5.quote: We adopt Qwen2.5VL-3B Bai et al. (2025) as the vision–language backbone and use the same task format as GUI-AiF Liu et al. (2026) for a controlled comparison.

AP7.quote: We evaluate on ScreenSpot-V1 (SSv1) Cheng et al. (2024) , ScreenSpot-V2 (SSv2) Wu et al. (2024) , and ScreenSpot-Pro (SSPro) Li et al. (2025) .

AP16.quote: Across methods, icon grounding remains more difficult than text grounding, likely because small icons provide limited visual evidence in dense professional interfaces.

title_zh: 面向计算机使用智能体的历史感知、视觉落地的评论家模型
one_line: 8B critic gives pre-execution, marker-grounded verdicts and compressed macro-action history to a frozen policy; live web/mobile/desktop gains, ablated, critic accuracy unmeasured.
one_line_zh: 训练 8B 评论家在执行前基于标记截图判定动作并提供压缩的宏动作历史，在网页、移动与桌面在线基准上提升且有消融，但评论家准确率未测。

online_eval.quote: Across all benchmarks, performance is measured by execution-based task success rates.

strong_baselines.quote: We simplify these into standard PRM templates using the same backbone model (Qwen3-VL-8B-Thinking) as our critic, and set N=2 to match the computational cost of verbal frameworks, which allow a maximum of two policy calls per step.

budget_matched.quote: set N=2 to match the computational cost of verbal frameworks, which allow a maximum of two policy calls per step.

cost_reported.quote: while the full pipeline requires two critic inferences per step, a single inference of either capability is already sufficient to achieve better results.

component_ablation.quote: To understand the individual contributions of visually grounded error analysis and history state tracking in our framework, we ablate these components on WebArenaLitev2, as shown in Table 2 .

validator_check.quote: If graded “Good”, the action is directly executed, advancing the GUI to the next observation o_{t+1} . If the action is rated “Bad”, the critic classifies the failure into one of the predefined errors and generates a verbal explanation.

evidence_level.quote: As shown in Table 1 , HiViG consistently improves both the open-weight Qwen3-VL-32B-Thinking and the frontier closed-source Gemini-3-Flash policies, achieving average absolute gains in overall success rate of 7.3% and 9.0% across the three domains, respectively.

S1.quote: Deploying either component alone outperforms all baselines.

S5.quote: We evaluate our test-time intervention on two CUA policies: Qwen3-VL-32B-Thinking ( Qwen Team, 2025 ) and Gemini-3-Flash ( Gemini Team, 2025 ) , representing open- and closed-weight models capable of navigating complex visual interfaces.

F1.quote: If graded “Good”, the action is directly executed, advancing the GUI to the next observation o_{t+1} . If the action is rated “Bad”, the critic classifies the failure into one of the predefined errors and generates a verbal explanation.

AP4.quote: If graded “Good”, the action is directly executed, advancing the GUI to the next observation o_{t+1} . If the action is rated “Bad”, the critic classifies the failure into one of the predefined errors and generates a verbal explanation.

title_zh: ISE：面向多轮操作系统智能体轨迹的执行落地数据合成方法
one_line: Synthesises multi-turn shell-agent SFT data from 4D sampled intents, a role-locked user simulator and live OS execution; single-trial LLM-judged ClawEval gains.
one_line_zh: 以四维意图采样、角色锁定的用户模拟器和真实系统执行合成多轮命令行智能体训练数据，在单次运行、LLM 评判的 ClawEval 上提升。

online_eval.quote: ClawEval , a multi-turn OS-agent execution benchmark whose tasks span three families by task-id prefix

variance.quote: All systems are evaluated under an identical configuration (vLLM, temperature 0 , single trial, LLM judge).

strong_baselines.quote: Baselines. (1) Base : Qwen3-8B zero-shot. (2) Qwen3-32B : a 4\times -larger open base, zero-shot, as a scale reference. (3) GPT-4o : zero-shot proprietary reference.

budget_matched.quote: In both cases the base model and training budget are held fixed and each variant is trained as a separate run

cost_reported.quote: Base model. Qwen3-8B, fine-tuned on 16 \times H800 80GB.

component_ablation.quote: For Stage 2 (multi-turn simulation), we truncate every trajectory to its first user turn, removing multi-turn simulation entirely.

validator_check.quote: All systems are evaluated under an identical configuration (vLLM, temperature 0 , single trial, LLM judge).

code.quote: We release all source code and dataset at https://github.com/Valiere01/ISE-Trace.

evidence_level.quote: SFT on ISETrace lifts Qwen3-8B’s ClawEval pass@1 from 19.3\% ( 22/114 ) to 37.7\% ( 43/114 )

F3.quote: Completion gating. The primary quality gate is the execution loop itself: a trajectory is retained only if the user simulator reaches completed = true within the turn cap

AP4.quote: Completion gating. The primary quality gate is the execution loop itself: a trajectory is retained only if the user simulator reaches completed = true within the turn cap

AP8.quote: All systems are evaluated under an identical configuration (vLLM, temperature 0 , single trial, LLM judge).

title_zh: 面向质量多样化网页智能体模仿学习的推测式回滚纠正
one_line: Student runs short branches, teacher rolls back to first harmful action and corrects; verified diverse trajectories plus corrections for SFT; live web and OSWorld-subset gains.
one_line_zh: 学生策略先执行短分支，教师定位首个有害动作并回滚纠正，结合验证通过的多样轨迹做 SFT，在网页与 OSWorld 子集在线评测中提升。

online_eval.quote: WebArena-Infinity is the primary benchmark, with programmatic verifiers and official easy, medium, and hard task buckets ( Zhou, 2026 ) .

held_out_env.quote: We also evaluate on WebArena-Lite and an OSWorld subset covering chrome , os , and LibreOffice applications ( Xie et al., 2024 ) ; the latter tests desktop transfer rather than full OSWorld leaderboard performance.

strong_baselines.quote: We compare the base model, expert-trajectory SFT, the final model trained with filtered SRC data, OEC-style random expert switch, and LEAP-style post-hoc privileged correction when available.

budget_matched.quote: Teacher queries are data-collection cost: first-shot branch reviews plus second-shot corrective interventions after rollback.

cost_reported.quote: We also report average episode steps and teacher queries per task.

component_ablation.quote: We use K=3 because it gives the best aggregate SR, 51.9%, with fewer teacher queries than K=1 (2529 vs. 3324). K=7 lowers cost further but drops to 50.6 SR.

validator_check.quote: After the branch is executed, the teacher reviewer returns either accept or an earliest harmful index j .

evidence_level.quote: The final teacher-free SRC model improves over Expert SFT on all three settings: +9.7 SR on WebArena-Infinity, +3.5 on WebArena-Lite, and +12.9 on the OSWorld subset.

S3.quote: If the branch is rejected at index j , SRC keeps the useful prefix before j , restores the environment to the corresponding state, queries a teacher corrector on the recovered observation, executes the corrective action, and resumes student rollout from the corrected state.

F3.quote: We also evaluate on WebArena-Lite and an OSWorld subset covering chrome , os , and LibreOffice applications ( Xie et al., 2024 ) ; the latter tests desktop transfer rather than full OSWorld leaderboard performance.

F5.quote: SRC assumes that the training environment can reset and replay branches with enough fidelity for rollback correction.

AP4.quote: After the branch is executed, the teacher reviewer returns either accept or an earliest harmful index j .

AP5.quote: The larger OSWorld gain suggests the rollback-collected data is not only fitting WebArena-Infinity trajectories.

AP8.quote: We also evaluate on WebArena-Lite and an OSWorld subset covering chrome , os , and LibreOffice applications ( Xie et al., 2024 ) ; the latter tests desktop transfer rather than full OSWorld leaderboard performance.

title_zh: ComAct：以 COM 作为动作范式重构专业软件操作
one_line: Replaces GUI actions with COM-script synthesis for real CAD software; 9B agent trained by SFT then GRPO on Chamfer reward; own executable benchmark.
one_line_zh: 以 COM 脚本生成替代 GUI 操作来控制真实 CAD 软件，9B 模型经 SFT 与基于倒角距离奖励的 GRPO 训练，在自建可执行基准上评测。

online_eval.quote: Valid Rate (VR) measures the percentage of error-free executing COM code, and Success Rate (SR) evaluates whether final artifacts pass task-specific criteria.

held_out_env.quote: Tasks are sourced from three public datasets Text2CAD [ 31 ] , Fusion360 Gallery [ 26 ] , SketchGraphs [ 25 ] , and supplemented with human-crafted instructions to cover real engineering workflows.

strong_baselines.quote: (1) GUI-based agents (GPT-5 [ 5 ] , Qwen3.5-9B [ 36 ] ) operating via screen coordinates and pixel actions; (2) COM-based general LLMs

budget_matched.quote: During evaluation, GUI and COM agents are limited to 35 interactive turns and 5 iterative code modifications, respectively.

cost_reported.quote: The training pipeline utilizes 12k samples for Stage 1, 30k for Stage 2, and 2,156 samples for Stage 3 (GRPO) focused on 3D modeling, assembly, and 2D sketches.

component_ablation.quote: We ablate the three training stages of ComActor on the single-task subset, with results summarized in Table 4 .

evidence_level.quote: Each sample includes a text instruction and a human-verified Ground Truth (GT) output, rigorously validated within our ComForge environment to ensure executability.

S5.quote: Unlike accessibility-oriented frameworks such as UI Automation (UIA) [ 9 ] , COM operates at the semantic object level, exposing application internals through structured programmatic interfaces across professional software including Microsoft Office and SolidWorks.

F6.quote: our experiments are currently limited to CAD software and the Windows ecosystem, primarily because many widely used professional applications expose native COM interfaces only on Windows.

AP5.quote: On the out-of-domain CADPrompt dataset, ComActor is tested in a zero-shot setting and establishes a dominant advantage in geometric fidelity, as shown in Table 3 .

title_zh: VISTA：面向 GUI 定位的视图一致自验证训练
one_line: GRPO grounding groups built from target-preserving crops with a self-verified gated oracle anchor; static grounding benchmarks, three scales, two backbone families, ablated.
one_line_zh: 以保留目标的多裁剪视图构建 GRPO 组并加入自验证门控的标准答案锚点训练 GUI 定位，在静态定位基准、多尺度与两类骨干上验证并消融。

online_eval.quote: We report results on five GUI-grounding benchmarks: ScreenSpot-Pro ( Li et al., 2025 ) , ScreenSpot-V2 ( Wu et al., 2024 ) , MMBench-GUI L2 ( Xuehui Wang and others, 2025 ) , OSWorld-G-R, and OSWorld-G ( Xie et al., 2025 ) .

strong_baselines.quote: For cross-backbone evaluation, we additionally train Qwen3.5-initialized models and compare VISTA against standard GRPO under the same backbone family.

budget_matched.quote: Compared with standard GRPO, VISTA incurs a moderate training overhead: across different model sizes, training for the same number of steps increases wall-clock time by approximately 25\% under the same training setup.

cost_reported.quote: We train VISTA on roughly 120K GUI-grounding samples curated from open-source datasets

component_ablation.quote: Within RL, dynamic crop alone improves standard GRPO from 63.4 to 64.3, while adaptive supervision alone improves it to 64.8.

evidence_level.quote: For all datasets, the model predicts a normalized coordinate in the 0 – 1000 frame, and a prediction is counted as correct when the point falls inside the target element.

S1.quote: Plain supervised crop augmentation has only a small effect on ScreenSpot-Pro, improving SFT from 59.8 to 60.5.

AP7.quote: For all datasets, the model predicts a normalized coordinate in the 0 – 1000 frame, and a prediction is counted as correct when the point falls inside the target element.
